items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Well, I don't know of any other Nickerson.

ctx.x: I thought one was marked, was listed as Junior or something, do you know of that?

Well, no I don't know of that but I was very young and just like I tell Professor Nickerson was wearing moustaches and goatees and he was pretty much in age then. So, and if Moneta took less of one of them it might have been his father. Yeah, that's what I remember. It might have been his father.
Yeah, that might have been the Junior that would still look elderly.
